function.name: write
function.arguments:
{"path": "summarization_comparison.py", "content": "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

# Data: Human evaluation scores (1-5 scale)
dimensions = ['Fluency', 'Coherence', 'Faithfulness']
systems = ['Extractive', 'Abstractive', 'LLM-based']

scores = {
    'Fluency': {'Extractive': 3.8, 'Abstractive': 4.3, 'LLM-based': 4.7},
    'Coherence': {'Extractive': 3.5, 'Abstractive': 4.0, 'LLM-based': 4.6},
    'Faithfulness': {'Extractive': 4.5, 'Abstractive': 3.6, 'LLM-based': 4.2}
}

# Set up the figure
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 6))

# Bar width and positions
bar_width = 0.25
x = np.arange(len(dimensions))

# Colors for each system
colors = ['#4CAF50', '#2196F3', '#9C27B0']  # Green, Blue, Purple

# Create grouped bars
bars1 = ax.bar(x - bar_width, [scores[d]['Extractive'] for d in dimensions],
               bar_width, label='Extractive', color=colors[0], edgecolor='black', linewidth=1.2)
bars2 = ax.bar(x, [scores[d]['Abstractive'] for d in dimensions],
               bar_width, label='Abstractive', color=colors[1], edgecolor='black', linewidth=1.2)
bars3 = ax.bar(x + bar_width, [scores[d]['LLM-based'] for d in dimensions],
               bar_width, label='LLM-based', color=colors[2], edgecolor='black', linewidth=1.2)

# Customize the chart
ax.set_xlabel('Evaluation Dimension', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax.set_ylabel('Human Evaluation Score (1-5)', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax.set_title('Comparison of Text Summarization Systems\nAcross Evaluation Dimensions', 
             fontsize=14, fontweight='bold', pad=20)
ax.set_xticks(x)
ax.set_xticklabels(dimensions, fontsize=11)
ax.set_ylim(0, 5.5)
ax.set_yticks(np.arange(0, 5.5, 0.5))
ax.grid(axis='y', linestyle='--', alpha=0.3)
ax.legend(title='System Type', fontsize=10, title_fontsize=11)

# Add value labels on top of each bar
for bars in [bars1, bars2, bars3]:
    for bar in bars:
        height = bar.get_height()
        ax.annotate(f'{height:.1f}',
                    xy=(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width() / 2, height),
                    xytext=(0, 3),
                    textcoords="offset points",
                    ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=9, fontweight='bold')

# Add annotations highlighting key insights
# Extractive excels at faithfulness
ax.annotate('Extractive\nmethods excel\nat faithfulness',
            xy=(2, 4.5), xytext=(2.5, 5.2),
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color='black', lw=1.5),
            fontsize=10, ha='center',
            bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.3', facecolor='lightgreen', alpha=0.7))

# LLM-based dominates fluency and coherence
ax.annotate('LLM-based methods\ndominate fluency\nand coherence',
            xy=(0, 4.7), xytext=(0.5, 5.3),
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color='black', lw=1.5),
            fontsize=10, ha='center',
            bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.3', facecolor='lightblue', alpha=0.7))

ax.annotate('Highest fluency\nand coherence scores',
            xy=(1, 4.6), xytext=(1.5, 5.2),
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color='black', lw=1.5),
            fontsize=9, ha='center',
            bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.3', facecolor='lightblue', alpha=0.7))

# Add summary text at the bottom
summary_text = 'Key Insight: Extractive methods prioritize faithfulness (staying true to source),\nwhile LLM-based methods excel at fluency and coherence (natural, well-structured text).'
ax.text(0.5, -0.15, summary_text,
        transform=ax.transAxes,
        fontsize=10,
        ha='center',
        va='bottom',
        bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.5', facecolor='lightyellow', alpha=0.8, edgecolor='orange'))

# Adjust layout and save
plt.tight_layout(rect=[0, 0.15, 1, 1])
plt.savefig('summarization_comparison.png', dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight', facecolor='white')
plt.close()

print("Chart saved as 'summarization_comparison.png'")"}
